agent-fallback.summary: Route failed or unavailable specialists through the capability fallback chain; respect retry limits, log coverage and triggers, and report degraded capability.

agent-friendly-code.summary: Keep generated code small, focused and greppable; follow size and complexity thresholds, use explicit modules and purpose comments, and extract additions from oversized files.

agent-generation-guardrails.summary: Check existing and proposed line counts before writing code; warn at 300 lines, split before 500, and extract large additions with descriptive names and purpose comments.

failure-mitigation.summary: Load validation context, detect and classify generation failures, apply archetype-specific mitigations and severity responses, and log issues without overstating evidence.

hitl-gates.summary: Require blocking human approval at SDLC phase transitions and artifact omissions; declare gate modes and conditions, track cost and rationale, and present decision context.

disposable-processes.summary: Start processes quickly and shut down gracefully on SIGTERM; drain or requeue work within the grace window, checkpoint before acknowledgment, and make retries safe.

lfd-control-tiers.summary: Distinguish harness-enforced, hybrid, and cooperative LFD controls; use mechanical budget stops as the adversarial backstop.

logs-as-event-streams.summary: Write application logs as unbuffered stdout/stderr event streams with correlation IDs; delegate routing and rotation to the environment.

provenance-tracking.summary: Record PROV entity, activity, agent, timestamps, and all derivations for generated artifacts; keep source mentions and bidirectional links consistent.

reproducibility-validation.summary: Validate critical workflow replay with five runs and documented match thresholds; record nondeterminism and produce compliance reproducibility reports.

research-metadata.summary: Give research documents FAIR frontmatter, verified identifiers, metric-bearing findings, GRADE quality, relevance fields, and PDF SHA-256 fixity records.

self-maintenance.summary: Use paired AIWG maintenance skills before raw action commands; preserve registry state and perform health checks before long orchestration sessions.

stateless-processes.summary: Externalize durable process state to backing services; document the process state model and justify local storage or sticky-session deviations in an ADR.

tao-loop.summary: Record complete intent/action/observation iterations, ground actions in observed results, vary strategy after flat cycles, and declare exploration quotas for long loops.

versioning.summary: Use YYYY.M.PATCH without leading zeros; keep package versions, v-prefixed release tags, and changelog entries consistent before release.
